description: This file contains implementation code for big number division functions, specifically the division and modulo operations for multi-precision integers in cryptographic computations.

methods.name: int BN_div(BIGNUM * dv,BIGNUM * rm,const BIGNUM * num,const BIGNUM * divisor,BN_CTX * ctx)
methods.description: Performs division of big numbers, dividing 'm' by 'd' producing quotient 'dv' and remainder 'rem'.

methods.name: int BN_mod(BIGNUM * rem,const BIGNUM * m,const BIGNUM * d,BN_CTX * ctx)
methods.description: Computes the remainder of division of 'm' by 'd' and stores in 'rem'.
